reply.text:
This is a gear question, so it's a preference more than a rule. Sleeves hold heat around the joint and give some proprioceptive feedback, and many lifters like how they feel on heavy sets. They don't make you stronger, and you don't need them to squat well.

If you're curious, try them on your heavier working sets and leave them off for warm-ups and lighter work, then see what you prefer. If they change how you move or what you trust under the bar, they're useful, and if you don't notice a difference, skip them.

If a knee is bothering you, that's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, and I'm happy to build around whatever they clear.
